channel.title: Russia's war in Ukraine · Varde Monitor
channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Putin in Russia after a positive meeting with President Zelenskyy, and Russia freed jailed American Stephen Hubbard who had fought for Ukraine. Ukraine carried out its first drone airlift of a wounded soldier from the front line, while Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv in a late-night attack injuring six people. Russia also launched missiles that hit Kyiv after agreeing to a US call to resume peace talks, and Putin ordered the release of the American detainee during the meeting. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
